lastCompletedStory.title: Central --help/-h short-circuit guard at the dispatch layer covering every command

nextStoryContext: US-001 added `HELP_REGISTRY: Record<string,string>` and `isHelpRequested(command, tail)` (both exported from index.ts) right before `switch (command)` in main(). Any NEW command case added to the switch in a future story MUST also get a HELP_REGISTRY entry or --help will fall through un-guarded into its body for that command. isHelpRequested treats --help/-h as matching anywhere in tail for every command except 'claude' (leading-only, to preserve arg-forwarding). US-002 (next story, requires US-001) adds the top-level HELP 'Internal' section listing sidecar/orch-recycle-watch/sidecar-liveness-watch/orch-budget plus --file-local doc for ISSUE_HELP -- it does NOT need to touch the guard/registry mechanism itself, just the human-facing top-level HELP text and a couple of *_HELP bodies. The pre-existing per-command `if (parsed.help)` checks inside each switch case are now dead code for the --help path (guard already returned 0) but were deliberately left in place (Surgical Changes); do not treat their presence as a bug.
